subject: Conditional expressions
notes: CONFORMS (kb/Work PB987, w54f). 'Values are established for arithmetic expressions and functions if and when the conditions containing them are evaluated': arithmetic expressions and intrinsic functions render inline inside the C# condition, so C#'s && / || short-circuit (8.8.4.13 1)) and the loop's re-test reach them per evaluation; every HOISTED activation - a user-defined function, an inline method invocation, a function-bearing subscript's temp store (DataBinder.PendingPreOps) and, since PB987, an object-property GET (DataBinder.OoPendingPropertyOps) - is drained by the per-evaluation window it was written in (UdfBinder.Mark marks BOTH lists): a PERFORM UNTIL / VARYING UNTIL condition, a SEARCH WHEN, an EVALUATE object, a non-first AND/OR operand, a VARYING BY / AFTER FROM operand, and runs at each evaluation or not at all. Negated conditions render as C# negation of the inner condition, evaluated when reached. Before PB987 a property reference in PERFORM UNTIL P OF S > 3 was fetched once for the whole loop (K=09 where the rule gives K=03). Witnesses: pb987_property_per_evaluation (UNTIL, AND/OR short-circuit, EVALUATE WHEN order, SEARCH WHEN, VARYING BY), udf_per_eval, pb17_function_subscript.
